name: model-router
description: Routes each turn and subagent to the cheapest Claude model that keeps quality, gated by a prompt-cache cost model.

mainLoop.title: Main loop routing
mainLoop.description: auto: route turns; shadow: log what it would do, change nothing; off: leave the main loop on /model.

subagents.title: Subagent routing
subagents.description: auto: pick a model for each spawned subagent; off: leave subagents alone.

fableMode.title: When Fable may be used
fableMode.description: manual: only ::fable or /route fable; escalation: also on a second rejection in a row; auto: also on the first rejection and when a prompt looks very hard.

minTier.title: Lowest model allowed
minTier.description: The router never picks a model below this one.

classifier.title: Ask Haiku on unclear prompts
classifier.description: When the keyword rules are unsure, ask Haiku to classify the prompt (about $0.0003 and under a second).

haikuEffort.title: Effort on Haiku detours
haikuEffort.description: Thinking effort for main-loop turns sent to Haiku. Haiku keeps its own prompt cache, so this never touches the home model's cache. inherit: the session's effort.

haikuModel.title: Haiku model id
haikuModel.description: Model id used for the haiku tier.

sonnetModel.title: Sonnet model id
sonnetModel.description: Model id used for the sonnet tier.

opusModel.title: Opus model id
opusModel.description: Model id used for the opus tier.

fableModel.title: Fable model id
fableModel.description: Model id used for the fable tier.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Prompt cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: How long a model's prompt cache is assumed to stay warm.

cacheWriteMultiplier.title: Cache write price multiplier
cacheWriteMultiplier.description: Cache write price as a multiple of input price: 2 for the 1-hour cache, 1.25 for the 5-minute one.

horizonTurns.title: Turns a downgrade is expected to last
horizonTurns.description: How many turns the cost model assumes a cheaper model will be used for before returning.

prices.title: Model prices
prices.description: Leave empty for the built-in prices. To override: tier=input/output/cacheRead in USD per million tokens, separated by ';', e.g. opus=4/20/0.2; haiku=0.1/0.5/0.01. Tiers left out keep the built-in price.

pricesAsOf.title: Date of your prices
pricesAsOf.description: YYYY-MM-DD date your prices were checked; /route warns when they are over 90 days old.
